turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did Owen see a zero on his phone before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
Walk me through what, exactly? What do you have besides a score?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
Created isn't the same as written. And a creation time doesn't explain why the zero went in before anyone called me.
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
I'm writing those times down. A student pasting in his own notes isn't misconduct, so show me the history itself.
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Don't. The history, Hale. Show it to me.
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
A misquote is a student remembering badly, nothing more. Show me the page where he wrote it.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
I'm not here to be complimented. Put the essay in front of me, Hale, with that line on it.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
Changing his argument between an outline and a final draft is called revising. I want both documents on paper, not just your account of them.
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the sole basis for adverse action, so give me the strongest thing you have on paper.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
There's no off the record, Hale, and I'm not sitting in your chair. I'm here for Owen's zero, so tell me what you're doing about it.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.
That's your own procedure, so put it in writing, private, with nothing on his record. And the zero comes out of the gradebook while I read what you've got.
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? The zero, Hale, and the writing.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.
I haven't refused it. I asked for it in writing, with the zero out while we sort it. If you'd rather take it to the vice principal Monday, I'll be at the principal's door first.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
That's not the only choice. I have ten minutes, so put the history and both drafts in front of me, then we talk about the rewrite in writing.
